# Saipem DS component catalog

77 components, tag prefix `sl-`. **DS** marks components that exist only in this design system, **custom** marks upstream components whose API was changed. Open the reference of every component before using it.

## Actions

| Component |  | Use it for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`<sl-button>`](components/button.md) | custom | Buttons represent actions that are available to the user. |
| [`<sl-button-group>`](components/button-group.md) |  | Button groups can be used to group related buttons into sections. |
| [`<sl-icon-button>`](components/icon-button.md) | custom | Icons buttons are simple, icon-only buttons that can be used for actions and in toolbars. |
| [`<sl-copy-button>`](components/copy-button.md) |  | Copies text data to the clipboard when the user clicks the trigger. |
| [`<sl-dropdown>`](components/dropdown.md) |  | Dropdowns expose additional content that "drops down" in a panel. |
| [`<sl-menu>`](components/menu.md) |  | Menus provide a list of options for the user to choose from. |
| [`<sl-menu-item>`](components/menu-item.md) |  | Menu items provide options for the user to pick from in a menu. |
| [`<sl-menu-label>`](components/menu-label.md) |  | Menu labels are used to describe a group of menu items. |

## Navigation and app shell

| Component |  | Use it for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`<sl-header>`](components/header.md) | **DS** | Headers are the brand bar at the top of an application: logo, main navigation and global actions such as the project picker and the user menu. |
| [`<sl-header-item>`](components/header-item.md) | **DS** | Header items are the entries in a [header's](components/header.md) main navigation. |
| [`<sl-sidebar>`](components/sidebar.md) | **DS** | Sidebars hold the secondary navigation of a page. |
| [`<sl-sidebar-group>`](components/sidebar-group.md) | **DS** | Sidebar groups are titled sections of a [sidebar](components/sidebar.md) that hold sidebar items. |
| [`<sl-sidebar-item>`](components/sidebar-item.md) | **DS** | Sidebar items are the links inside a [sidebar group](components/sidebar-group.md). |
| [`<sl-breadcrumb>`](components/breadcrumb.md) |  | Breadcrumbs provide a group of links so users can easily navigate a website's hierarchy. |
| [`<sl-breadcrumb-item>`](components/breadcrumb-item.md) |  | Breadcrumb Items are used inside [breadcrumbs](components/breadcrumb.md) to represent different links. |

| [`<sl-tab>`](components/tab.md) | custom | Tabs are used inside [tab groups](components/tab-group.md) to represent and activate [tab panels](components/tab-panel.md). |
| [`<sl-tab-panel>`](components/tab-panel.md) |  | Tab panels are used inside [tab groups](components/tab-group.md) to display tabbed content. |
| [`<sl-stepper>`](components/stepper.md) | **DS** | Steppers show where the user is in a multi-step process, such as creating and distributing a document. |
| [`<sl-step>`](components/step.md) | **DS** | Steps are the individual stages of a [stepper](components/stepper.md). |
